Roof spec (roof.json, palette-only deepslate tile, civic hip, 4 stack keeps, trusses: fink x11 doubled) lays through runParts; parts/roofs.mjs adds 4 brick stacks with caps and signal campfires, room hearths and the hand-built rear porch shed roof.
Exterior of the roof, stacks above the eave and the porch roof are built; make.sh writes a whole build.nbt with no off-palette blocks.
Blocked: 224 writes into the stacks and hearths inside the rooms are REFUSED because shell.mjs line 78 carves those cells to air (and hole(y) at y3/10/17); a scratch copy with those carves removed places all 448 with 0 refused.

waste.what: Diagnosing why 224 writes were refused: I read runParts' ownership code and grepped the shell's carve calls by hand to find that shell.mjs line 78 owns the stack cells as air.
waste.tool: runParts report should name the owning part and the cell's earlier write (e.g. 'owned by mansion shell: open(33,4,46)'), and MCD_PARTS_CELLS should write into parts-report.json instead of nowhere

waste.what: Rewriting roof.json material by trial: the civic/slate preset expands to tuff_brick and cobbled/polished stairs, so I iterated dry-runs until the mix was a single deepslate_tile.
waste.tool: mcd roof --spec should take a palette (or the roles in palette.json) and restrict the derived stairs/slabs to it, so a 'slate' preset stays on-palette without hand-picking a mix

waste.what: Checking dormers: the dry-run report said 'dormers 0/2' while the notes only dropped the two south dormers; I could not tell from the report which north dormers landed.
waste.tool: mcd roof --dry-run --json should list each dormer with placed/dropped and its cells

waste.what: Hand-coding the rear porch shed roof stairs and solid fill cell by cell (z76..80 x37..58).
waste.tool: a roof rect option for a lean-to / shed roof in roof.json (footprint + high side + pitch) would replace the hand loop

companions.task: Own the shell's stack carves: keep the four brick stacks solid through the floors and hand over the in-room cells (y4..16) so the hearths can carve their fireboxes.
Lay the chimney stacks and fireboxes in the rooms (2x2 brick with deepslate band, signal fire cap, 1x1 firebox with lintel) once the shell releases the cells.
Fit the north and south dormers' glass panes and smooth quartz cheeks, including the two south dormers the roof tool dropped at the rear eave.

left: Hearths: no firebox, campfire, lintel exists in any room. All 8 fireboxes per stack were refused by the shell's line 78 carve (y4..5, y11..12). Needs shell.mjs to stop carving the stacks, then a rerun.
Stack interiors y3..16 are missing for the same reason: 224 refused writes in the roofs line. The stacks above the roof and the cap are built.

South dormers (2) dropped by the roof tool: the roof does not rise over a 3-wide dormer within 4 rows of the rear eave. The tool still warns ROOF_BIG_PLANE on the south slope. Either drop them or move them up the slope; I did not change the plan.
Rear porch shed roof built by hand (deepslate tile stairs at y10 z76..78 and y9 z79..80, solid tile under the high rows). The smooth_quartz_slab fascia under the eave is not placed.
Campfires are set with lit and signal_fire true at the stack tops; the cap is the chimneyStack helper's ring at y27, not the plan's y28.
plan.md Checklist marked [~] 2 with a Notes line for the shell conflict; elements.md ticked the roof and exterior chimney items.
